plugin.name: Manhunt Widescreen Fix
hudaspect.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: the radar at the left edge, status, health, inventory and timer at the right edge. A ratio keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect. Menus always keep their 4:3 design.
fmvmode.description: How the game's videos fill a widescreen display.
windowmode.description: Fullscreen, a window at the resolution chosen at startup, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Needs a restart.
confinecursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game's window while the game is in front, so it can't slip onto another monitor. It's let go when you switch to another window or move the window.
fpslimit.description: Caps the frame rate without the game's busy wait. The game itself never runs faster than 200 fps.
fov.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. Cutscenes, menus and zoomed views are not changed.
skipintro.description: Skips the startup legal screen wait and the opening logo video. Needs a restart.
textlanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the game's language.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
